definitions.explanation: Visiting a place to observe and learn about it, often in an educational context.

examples.japanese: {工場|こうじょう}{見学|けんがく}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went on a factory tour.

examples.japanese: {授業|じゅぎょう}を{見学|けんがく}させていただけますか。
{見学|けんがく}{者|しゃ}は{写真|しゃしん}{撮影|さつえい}{禁止|きんし}です。
examples.english: Visitors are prohibited from taking photos.

notes:
{見学|けんがく} refers to visiting somewhere to observe and learn.

Common collocations:
- {見学|けんがく}に{行|い}く (to go on a tour/visit)
- {見学|けんがく}を{申|もう}し{込|こ}む (to apply for a tour)
- {見学|けんがく}{者|しゃ} (visitor, observer)
- {見学|けんがく}{希望|きぼう} (wishing to observe)

Types of {見学|けんがく}:
- {工場|こうじょう}{見学|けんがく} (factory tour)
- {社会|しゃかい}{見学|けんがく} (social studies field trip)
- {授業|じゅぎょう}{見学|けんがく} (class observation)
- {施設|しせつ}{見学|けんがく} (facility tour)

Related terms:
- {参観|さんかん} (visit, observation - often for classes)
- ツアー (tour - loanword)
